title: Tensor products of tilde modules on an affine scheme
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let $M,N$ be $R$-modules. Let $\widetilde M$ and $\widetilde N$ be the quasi-coherent sheaves of [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], with canonical maps $\tau_M:M\to\widetilde M(X)$ and $\tau_N:N\to\widetilde N(X)$. Define $\widetilde M\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\widetilde N$ using the sheafification in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. The canonical $\mathcal O_X$-linear map $\widetilde{M\otimes_RN}\to\widetilde M\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\widetilde N$ is the unique map whose sectionwise sheafification map sends $\tau_{M\otimes N}(m\otimes n)$ to $\tau_M(m)\otimes\tau_N(n)$. It is an isomorphism, and its component on $X$ identifies the canonical map $M\otimes_RN\to(\widetilde M\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\widetilde N)(X)$ with a bijection. This is Schemes, Lemmas 01I7 and 01I8(1), together with Modules, Lemma 01CE(3).

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01I7 (lemma-compare-constructions) and Lemma 01I8 (lemma-widetilde-constructions), item (1); Modules, Lemma 01CE (lemma-tensor-product-permanence), item (3)
